_note: International channel (@bibleinonescroll) layout as rules (관리자 2026-11-13 '앞으로 영상들 생성될 것 고려해서'). `node motion/youtube/intl-layout.mjs plan` shows what differs from these rules; `apply` fixes it (API, ~50 units per change). Ids come from uploaded.json (global.*) — new films appear here by being recorded there. Foreign Shorts are what gets seen; long videos are reached from Shorts and playlists, so every rule below is about the path Short → long video.

language_playlist._note: One public playlist per language = everything watchable in that language, in this order. A series film goes into EVERY language playlist whose language it has captions or audio for (global.films.<film>.h.captions / audio). A new language gets its playlist created (title/description = that language's site brand + film blurb, as the existing ones).

series_playlist._note: The international twin of the Korean 「해설 영상 모아 보기」: the series films (horizontal) in story order. English title + localized titles (reviewed lines only).
series_playlist.title: Bible stories, one by one
series_playlist.description: Short films that follow the Bible story one piece at a time — each with captions in many languages.

es.title: Historias de la Biblia, una a una
es.description: Películas cortas que siguen la historia de la Biblia paso a paso, cada una con subtítulos en muchos idiomas.

pt-BR.title: Histórias da Bíblia, uma a uma
pt-BR.description: Filmes curtos que acompanham a história da Bíblia passo a passo, cada um com legendas em muitos idiomas.

home._note: Channel home sections, top to bottom. The visitor trailer (unsubscribedTrailer) stays the English 14-min film until a narrated English version exists (then that). The 'featured video for returning subscribers' has no API — set it in Studio → Customization → Layout to the newest series film.

channel_localizations._note: Channel description per language so a Spanish viewer reads Spanish: the language playlist's own (already reviewed) description + the site link for that language + the Korean channel. No language counts (관리자 2026-11-13). Title stays 'Bible in One Scroll'.

related._note: A Short's related video (Studio only, no API): scene Shorts → that language's 14-min main video (narrated when it exists); series Shorts → the film's horizontal version. `plan` lists the Shorts whose related video must change when a narrated version appears.
